question: Paras can complete 40% of the work in 8 days while Deepti & Paras together can complete 10% of the work in a day. Find the time taken by Deepti alone to complete the work.
solution:
Given:

Paras can complete 40% of the work in 8 days while Deepti & Paras together can complete 10% of the work in a day.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per day) × Total time taken 

Calculation:

Considering, the total work to be 100%.

Paras does = (40/8)% = 5% work a day.

Hence, Deepti does = (10 - 5)% = 5% work a day.

Thus, time taken by Deepti to complete the work = (100/5) = 20 days.

∴ The time taken by Deepti alone to complete the work is 20 days.
